THIS WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 05.08.2025, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 2025:KER:58425 W.P.(C) No.5656/2025  :3:
 JUDGMENT Dated this the 5th day of August, 2025
The petitioner states that she is a lady Advocate practicing at Thrissur, Ernakulam and Alappuzha.

Prasanth K.S., Clerk of Advocate Sri.E.Rafeek, came in his bike bearing Register No.KL-32-5240 from south to north from the north corner of District Court,
Alappuzha towards the Sree Narayana Guru Statue through the wrong side on 30 th October, 2024 at 3.24 pm and hit the petitioner using his bike as a weapon.
She fell down and sustained injuries.
2. The petitioner called Control Room and police came to the spot.
The petitioner also received a SMS KL-01-BT- 7941 with number 6238904390 assigned.
An ID 1165266 is numbered.
On the same day, the petitioner went to North Police Station and submitted complaint.

On 11.12.2024, while the 2025:KER:58425 petitioner was sitting at the Chief Judicial Magistrate Court, Alappuzha,
Prashanth came from behind, used obscene language and pulled her gown.
Again the petitioner called police at 12.14 pm.
The petitioner received an SMS from police with ID 1204994.
Police came from North Police Station.
By the time police came, the accused escaped.
Thereafter, the petitioner told the CJM about the attack.
The petitioner is seeking direction to the police to register appropriate crime against Prashanth and Rafeek and give her adequate police protection.

Chithranjali vs Prashanth.K.S on 5 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/95217315/
2 3.
I have heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Government Pleader representing respondents 3 to 9.
Though notice was served on respondents 1 and 2, there is no representation for the respondents when the case was called.
4. The grievance of the petitioner is that respondents 1 and 2 are threatening the petitioner.
The petitioner is a practicing lawyer.
The petitioner is not in a position 2025:KER:58425 to go even to Courts.
The petitioner points out an instance of falling down due to hitting by the bike.
5. Considering the facts of the case, I am of the view that the petitioner should be given protection as and when situation warrants.

The writ petition is therefore disposed of directing that if the petitioner brings to the notice of the 3rd respondent any instance of violence or coercion from the part of respondents 1 and 2, the 3rd respondent shall look into the matter and take necessary steps to give protection to the life of the petitioner.

Sd/-
